info.title: ControlHome API
info.description: Same-origin API of the ControlHome web app. Mutating requests must send an Origin header equal to the app's origin and the header 'X-ControlHome: 1'. Errors are RFC 7807 ProblemDetails with a stable 'code'.

get.summary: First-run state; answers even while the database is not ready.

post.summary: Pre-database setup: tests the SQL Server connection, saves it (encrypted) and starts the database initialization.
post.description: Only while no database connection is configured (else 409 db.already_configured); answers even while the database is not ready. 400: validation.failed, setup.invalid_code, db.connection_failed (extension reason), sql.version_unsupported or sql.compatibility_unsupported; 409: db.create_denied (extension script: T-SQL for an administrator) or db.already_configured. 202: saved; poll GET /api/setup/status until databaseState is Ready.

post.summary: Creates the first Admin and the home, then signs the admin in.
Signs in with user name and password (sets the session cookie).
Ends the session (always 204).
Sets a new password with a one-time token from 'reset-admin <user>'.
Confirms the safety PIN: allows one safety-critical command (unlock, open the gate, disarm) within 60 s.
post.description: 409 safety.pin_not_set; 400 safety.pin_incorrect; 423 safety.locked (retryAfterSeconds) after 5 wrong PINs within 15 minutes, which also blocks safety-critical commands for 15 minutes.

get.summary: The signed-in user.

put.summary: Changes the signed-in user's display name, language and theme.

post.summary: Changes the signed-in user's password.

get.summary: Whether the signed-in user has a safety PIN, and any lockout.

put.summary: Sets the safety PIN (4–8 digits) for safety-critical commands: the first one with the account password (currentPassword), a change with the current PIN (currentPin) or, if forgotten, the account password.
put.description: 400 validation.failed; safety.password_required (no PIN set yet, or neither currentPin nor currentPassword); safety.pin_incorrect (wrong currentPin; counts as a failed attempt); auth.password_incorrect (wrong currentPassword; counts towards the account lockout); 423 safety.locked (retryAfterSeconds) after 5 wrong PINs within 15 minutes, or auth.locked_out.

get.summary: All accounts.

post.summary: Creates an account.

put.summary: Changes display name, role or disabled state (the last active Admin is protected).

delete.summary: Deletes the account (never yourself, never the last active Admin).

post.summary: Sets a new password for the account.

delete.summary: Clears the account's safety PIN and any safety lockout; the user sets a new PIN with their password.

get.summary: The home's settings.
Audit entries, newest first; pass nextCursor back as cursor for the next page.
All floors, by level.

post.summary: Creates an empty floor (default size 2000 × 1500 cm, grid 50 cm).

get.summary: A floor with its rooms.

put.summary: Changes name, level, size, grid and background.
put.description: 409 floors.concurrency when rowVersion is not the floor's current one (reload it). 400 validation.failed, also when the new size would cut a room or a placed device (errors.widthCm / errors.heightCm = geometry.out_of_bounds) or the background file does not exist (errors['background.fileId'] = files.not_found).

delete.summary: Deletes the floor and its rooms.
delete.description: 404 floors.not_found; 409 floors.not_empty while devices are placed on it (take them off the plan first).

put.summary: Replaces the floor's rooms atomically (rooms not listed are deleted).
put.description: Placed devices whose point ends up in another room (or in none) move to that room. 409 floors.concurrency when rowVersion is not the floor's current one (reload it). 400 validation.failed with field errors; geometry problems are codes under rooms[i].polygon: geometry.too_few_points, geometry.too_many_points, geometry.out_of_bounds, geometry.zero_area, geometry.self_intersecting; rooms[i].id = rooms.not_found for a room that is not on this floor.

get.summary: All rooms of all floors, by floor level and room order.
Every endpoint and device on the floor plans (optionally of one floor), with the room each is in.

parameters.name: floorId
parameters.description: Only the placements of this floor.

put.summary: Places an endpoint or a whole device on a floor (or moves it); its room becomes the room at that point.
put.description: Exactly one of endpointId and deviceId. The target's room is set to the room whose outline contains the point, or cleared when it is outside every room (an endpoint then shows in its device's room). 400 validation.failed with errors.floorId = floors.not_found, errors.endpointId = endpoints.not_found, errors.deviceId = devices.not_found, or errors.xCm / errors.yCm = geometry.out_of_bounds.

delete.summary: Takes an endpoint or device off the plan (its room is kept).

post.summary: Uploads an image (multipart: file, purpose=floor-background); it is stored re-encoded as WebP.
post.description: PNG, JPEG or WebP (recognized by content, not name), at most 10 MB and 40 megapixels; the stored image is WebP, at most 4096 px on its longest side, without metadata. 400: files.unsupported_type, files.too_large, files.invalid_image, or validation.failed (unknown purpose); 413 request.too_large for requests over 16 MB.

get.summary: The file's bytes (cacheable for a year: files never change).
Every capability definition: attributes (schemas, units, state classes) and commands (arguments, safety flags).
Devices with their endpoints, capabilities, attribute ids and current values, by name.
get.description: Filters (all optional, combined): roomId, integrationId, capability (e.g. switch), q (name, manufacturer or model).

parameters.name: roomId
parameters.description: Devices with at least one endpoint in the room (an endpoint's own room, else the device's).

parameters.name: capability
parameters.description: Devices with an endpoint that has this (non-retired) capability, e.g. `switch`.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text contained in the name, manufacturer or model.

get.summary: A device with its vendor details, endpoints and child devices.

put.summary: Renames a device and sets its icon and room.
put.description: 400 validation.failed (errors.roomId = rooms.not_found for an unknown room); 404 devices.not_found.

post.summary: Replaces this device by another: the new one takes over its settings, placements and history.
post.description: Moves name, room, icon, endpoint names/rooms/icons/hidden/favorites (endpoints matched by key, or the only one of each), placements and history (state log, events, statistics, energy) to newDeviceId, then deletes this device. Typically for an orphaned device after re-pairing, or a likely duplicate (possibleDuplicateIds). Returns the new device. 404 devices.not_found; 400 validation.failed with errors.newDeviceId = devices.not_found or devices.replace_same; 409 runtime.standby (this instance is a read-only standby); 503 runtime.starting (still deciding whether it runs the devices).

put.summary: Changes an endpoint's name, icon, room and hidden flag.
put.description: 400 validation.failed (errors.roomId = rooms.not_found for an unknown room); 404 endpoints.not_found.

put.summary: Adds the endpoint to the dashboard's favorites, or removes it.

get.summary: The camera's latest still image (an endpoint with the camera capability).
get.description: Not cached (Cache-Control: no-store). 404 endpoints.not_found, or cameras.no_snapshot (not a camera, or no picture right now); 503 commands.unavailable (its integration is not running).

post.summary: Sends a command to an endpoint; progress arrives as hub CommandStatus messages.
post.description: 202 with the command id. 400 commands.unsupported (no such capability or command on this endpoint) or commands.invalid_arguments (errors['arguments.<key>'] = commands.argument_*); 403 safety.step_up_required (safety-critical: POST /api/auth/step-up first, then resend with the same idempotencyKey) or safety.not_allowed; 404 endpoints.not_found; 409 commands.duplicate (idempotency key already used) or commands.gate_closed; 423 safety.locked (retryAfterSeconds); 503 commands.unavailable (integration not running).

get.summary: Every attribute's current value (resync after a hub reconnect).
The connectors of this build (descriptors: names, icon, config forms, features).
All integrations with their status and device count, by name.

post.summary: Creates an integration from a connector key and its config; its runtime starts right away.
post.description: 400 validation.failed (errors.connectorKey = connectors.not_found for an unknown connector) or integrations.invalid_config (errors['config.<key>'] = commands.argument_* codes); 409 runtime.standby (this instance is a read-only standby: make the change on the active one); 503 runtime.starting (this instance is still deciding whether it runs the devices: try again in a moment). Secret config fields are stored encrypted and never returned.

put.summary: Renames an integration and enables or disables it.
put.description: Disabling stops its runtime (status Stopped; devices are kept, availability Unknown); enabling starts it. 404 integrations.not_found; 409 runtime.standby; 503 runtime.starting.

delete.summary: Stops the integration and deletes it with all its devices and their state.
delete.description: 404 integrations.not_found; 409 runtime.standby (this instance is a read-only standby); 503 runtime.starting (still deciding whether it runs the devices).

post.summary: Starts a connector's setup flow and returns its first step.
post.description: Answer each step with POST /api/integrations/flows/{flowId} until a done (the integration was created: integrationId) or abort step. Connectors without a flow of their own get one form with their config fields. Flows are kept in memory for 15 minutes after their last step and belong to the admin who started them. 400 validation.failed (errors.connectorKey = connectors.not_found); 409 runtime.standby; 503 runtime.starting.

post.summary: Answers the flow's current step and returns the next one.
post.description: input: a form's values (secret fields are write-only), {"choice": key}, a pasted value, or {} to poll a progress step. A done step created (setup) or updated (reauth) the integration with its secrets encrypted and started its runtime. 404 flows.not_found (finished, cancelled, expired, or another admin's); 409 runtime.standby; 503 runtime.starting.

delete.summary: Abandons a flow (nothing is created or changed).
delete.description: An answer still being processed finishes first. 404 flows.not_found (also when that answer finished the flow: then its done step is what happened).

post.summary: Starts the connector's flow for an existing integration: re-authorize it or change its settings.
post.description: Its devices, names, rooms and history are kept; the done step updates the configuration and replaces the secrets, then restarts the integration. 404 integrations.not_found or connectors.not_found (the connector is not in this version); 409 runtime.standby; 503 runtime.starting.

get.summary: Runtime mode (Starting, Active, Standby), whether history is paused, and the app version.
An attribute's history over a range, oldest point first (at most 5 000 points).
get.description: resolution=auto (default) serves raw changes for ranges up to 6 h, 5-minute statistics up to 7 days and hourly statistics beyond (the finest that fits in 5 000 points and whose rows are still kept for `from`: raw history and 5-minute statistics are purged after their retention); attributes without statistics (states such as on/off or modes) always get raw changes. Raw series start with the value in effect at `from`. Statistics trail real time by the rollup (about a minute after a bucket ends). 400 history.invalid_resolution, history.invalid_range (from not before to) or history.range_too_large (over 366 days); 404 attributes.not_found.

get.summary: Energy used per endpoint and hour, by hour then endpoint.
get.description: Hours overlapping [from, to) (default: the last 24 h). Each endpoint has one source: its energy meter (counter) or, without one, its power readings integrated (integratedPower, estimated). 400 history.invalid_range, history.range_too_large or energy.too_many_rows (over 20 000 rows: pick a shorter range or one endpoint — a year of one endpoint always fits); 404 endpoints.not_found.

get.summary: How long history is kept (the defaults until saved).

put.summary: Changes how long history is kept; the hourly retention job applies it.
put.description: Days: stateLogDays, shortTermStatsDays and deviceEventDays 1–365, auditLogDays 30–3650 (400 validation.failed otherwise). Hourly statistics and hourly energy are kept forever; nothing a rollup still needs is purged.

get.summary: The home at a glance: favorites, rooms (active devices, temperature, power), power now, offline devices, integrations.
get.description: Values are current when served. Keep them live by applying hub StateChanged deltas to the listed attribute ids (rooms[].temperatureAttributeIds / powerAttributeIds / activityAttributes, power.attributeIds) and refetch on DevicesChanged and IntegrationStatusChanged.

get.summary: Downloads a backup of the home configuration (zip) without the integrations' secrets.
get.description: Zip: manifest.json (schemaVersion), home.json, floors.json, files.json + files/<id>.<ext>, integrations.json, devices.json, endpoints.json, placements.json, users.json (no password hashes or PINs). History is not included. For a backup with secrets use POST /api/backup/export with a passphrase (kept out of URLs).

post.summary: Downloads a backup (zip); with a passphrase it includes the integrations' secrets, encrypted.
post.description: Secrets are encrypted with AES-256-GCM, the key derived from the passphrase with PBKDF2-SHA256 (600 000 iterations); the same passphrase is needed to import them. 400 validation.failed (passphrase of 12–256 characters).

post.summary: Restores a backup (multipart: file, optional passphrase) into an empty home.
post.description: Only when the home has no floors, integrations or devices (409 backup.not_empty). Floors, rooms, files, integrations (started right away), devices, endpoints, placements and missing user accounts (without passwords: reset them) are restored in one transaction. 400 backup.invalid, backup.unsupported_version, backup.passphrase_required, backup.passphrase_incorrect; 409 runtime.standby; 413 request.too_large over 200 MB; 503 runtime.starting.

get.summary: The automatic backups: the schedule, whether the last attempt failed, and the files kept.
get.description: The server writes a backup without credentials to its data folder on a schedule (daily, keeping seven by default). LastFailedAtUtc is set while the last attempt failed and none succeeded since.

post.summary: Writes an automatic backup now (whatever the schedule) and answers with it.
post.description: Older backups beyond the number kept are deleted. 503 backup.write_failed when the data folder cannot be written.

get.summary: Downloads one automatic backup (zip) by its name.
get.description: Only the names listed by GET /api/backup/scheduled; any other name is 404 backup.not_found.

attribute.description: The attribute it sets (its constraints apply), if any.

ArgumentDefinitionDto.description: An argument of a command (a member of the command's `arguments` object).

schema.description: The value's shape (discriminator `type`: bool, number, enum, string, flags, json, momentary).

recorded.description: Whether changes are kept in the history.

writable.description: Whether a command of the capability changes it.

attributeId.description: The key of every state, history and hub delta for this attribute.

value.description: The current value; `{kind:'null'}` when none was reported yet.

observedAtUtc.description: When the value was observed, or `null` when none was reported yet.

lastChangedAtUtc.description: When the value last changed, or `null`.

restored.description: Loaded from the database and not yet confirmed by the running connector.

AttributeDto.description: One attribute and its current value.

restored.description: Loaded from the database and not yet confirmed by the running connector.

AttributeStateDto.description: The current value of one attribute (`GET /api/state` resync, and the source of AttributeDto).

detailsJson.description: Optional JSON object with action details.

AuditEntryDto.description: One audit log entry, newest first in listings.

AvailabilityChangedDto.description: A device became reachable or not (hub `AvailabilityChanged`).

usersCreated.description:
Accounts created from the backup (it holds no passwords: an admin sets one for each with a password reset); accounts
whose user name already exists are left as they are.

secretsRestored.description: The integrations' secrets were in the backup and the passphrase opened them.

CapabilityDto.description: A capability definition as served by `GET /api/capabilities` (and inside generic endpoint capabilities).

CommandAcceptedDto.description: The command was accepted; its progress arrives as hub `CommandStatus` messages with this id.

timeoutMs.description: Confirmation timeout; `null` uses the connector's default.

safetyCritical.description: Always needs a step-up PIN (unlock, door opener, disarm).

safetyCriticalForDeviceClasses.description: Device classes on which it needs a step-up PIN too (cover open on gate/garage).

failSafe.description: The safe direction (lock, close): never gated.

gateAttribute.description: A boolean attribute that must be true for the command to be accepted, if any.

capabilityId.description: A capability of the endpoint, e.g. `switch`.

command.description: A command of that capability, e.g. `turnOn` or `setLevel`.

oneOf.description: The arguments object (e.g. `{"level": 40}`); omit or `null` for none.

idempotencyKey.description:
Unique per user action (1–128 of `A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -`; a UUID is fine). The same key again within 10 minutes is
refused with 409 `commands.duplicate` and never reaches the device (at-most-once). Send the same key when retrying
the same action (e.g. after a step-up). The server generates one when omitted.

commandId.description: The id from the command's 202 response.

status.description:
`pending` (accepted, not done yet), then one final status: `confirmed`, `failed`, `timed_out` or
        `superseded` (a later command for the same control replaced it before it was sent).

code.description: For `failed` and `timed_out`: an error code (`commands.*`), translated as `errors.<code>`.

CommandStatusDto.description: Progress of a command sent with `POST /api/endpoints/{id}/commands` (hub `CommandStatus`).

setupCode.description: The one-time setup code from the server log or `setup-code.txt` (dashes/spaces ignored).

loadDemoHome.description:
Also load the demo home (two floors, eight rooms, a Simulated integration with about 20 devices placed on the plans),
named in the home's language. Skipped when the home already has floors, integrations or devices.

CompleteSetupRequest.description: Completes the first-run setup: creates the first Admin and the home, then signs the admin in.

key.description: Stable id, e.g. `simulated`; used as `connectorKey` when creating an integration.

icon.description: Icon key (lucide name, or a prefixed key such as `mdi:…`).

configFields.description: The integration's configuration form (rendered with the shared schema form).

deviceConfigFields.description: Per-device settings, usually secret; empty when none.

ConnectorDto.description: A connector in the integrations catalogue (`GET /api/connectors`).

setupFlow.description:
The connector has a setup flow of its own (several steps); others get a single config form. Either way, set up through
`POST /api/integrations/flows`.

reauth.description: The flow can re-authorize an existing integration (`POST /api/integrations/{id}/flows/reauth`), keeping its devices.

oneOf.description:
A form's values (secret fields included, write-only), a choice (`{"choice":"key"}`), a pasted value, or an
empty object to poll a progress step or confirm an external page; `null` counts as an empty object.

ContinueFlowRequest.description: Answers the flow's current step (`POST /api/integrations/flows/{flowId}`, Admin).

CreateFloorRequest.description: Creates an empty floor (Admin). Size defaults to 2000 × 1500 cm, grid 50 cm.

oneOf.description: The config object (members per the connector's config fields); secret fields are stored encrypted and never returned.

CreateIntegrationRequest.description: Creates an integration from a connector's config fields (`POST /api/integrations`; no setup flow in 1.2).

DashboardActivityDto.description: A device counts as active while this attribute has one of ActiveValues.

DashboardDeviceDto.description: A device in a dashboard list.

favoriteEndpointIds.description: Favorite endpoints (not hidden) in display order: render them with the device tiles.

rooms.description: Every room of every floor, by floor level and room order (empty: point to the floor editor).

offlineDevices.description: Devices their connector reports as unreachable (orphaned devices are left out).

integrations.description: Every integration with its status (empty: point to the integrations page).

DashboardDto.description:
The home at a glance (`GET /api/dashboard`): favorites, rooms with what is on / the temperature / the power drawn,
the power drawn now, offline devices and integration health. Values are current when served; to keep them live, apply
hub `StateChanged` deltas to the listed attribute ids, and refetch on `DevicesChanged`.

DashboardPowerDto.description: The power drawn now: the sum of every `power.power` reading (W, one decimal; `null` without readings).

deviceCount.description: Devices with at least one endpoint in the room.

activeDeviceCount.description:
Devices with something on in the room: a switch on, a media player powered, an appliance running (see
ActivityAttributes).

temperatureC.description: The mean of the room's temperature readings (°C, one decimal), or `null` when it has none.

powerW.description: The sum of the room's power readings (W, one decimal), or `null` when it has none.

temperatureAttributeIds.description: The temperature readings averaged into TemperatureC.

powerAttributeIds.description: The power readings summed into PowerW.

activityAttributes.description: What makes a device count as active, to recount from live values.

DashboardRoomDto.description: One room's summary. Endpoints count in their own room, else their device's; hidden endpoints are left out.

host.description: Host name or IP address of the SQL Server, as the ControlHome server (container) resolves it.

database.description: The application database; created by ControlHome when the login may create databases.

DatabaseSetupRequest.description:
Pre-database setup: the SQL Server connection to test and save. Accepted only while no connection is configured.
The connection always uses TLS (`Encrypt=True`); TrustServerCertificate accepts the server's
own (usually self-signed) certificate.

DeviceChildDto.description: A child device of a DeviceDetailDto.

externalId.description: The connector's id for the device.

children.description: Devices reached through this one (e.g. an NVR's cameras), by name.

possibleDuplicateIds.description: Devices of other integrations with the same MAC address or serial number.

DeviceDetailDto.description: A device with its vendor details (`GET /api/devices/{id}`).

parentDeviceId.description: The device it is reached through (an NVR for a camera), if any.

isOrphaned.description: No longer reported by its integration (kept, shown with a badge).

possibleDuplicateIds.description:
Devices of other integrations with the same MAC address or serial number: most likely the same hardware reached twice
(remove one, or move this one's settings and history with `POST /api/devices/{id}/replace`). Empty when none.

DeviceSummaryDto.description: A device in the device list, with its endpoints, capabilities, attribute ids and current values.

retired.description: No longer reported by the connector: hide its controls (history is kept).

oneOf.description: The endpoint's narrowing (ranges, enum subsets) as a constraints object, or `null`.

attributes.description: The attributes known so far (ordered by key).

EndpointCapabilityDto.description: A capability of an endpoint with its constraints and attributes.

key.description: The connector's key (`main` for single-endpoint devices).

name.description: The user's name, or `null` to show the device name.

roomId.description: The endpoint's own room, or `null` to inherit the device's.

effectiveRoomId.description: The room the endpoint is in: its own, else the device's.

hidden.description: Left out of dashboards and pickers.

EndpointDto.description: A controllable part of a device (commands address endpoints).

source.description: `counter` (its energy meter) or `integratedPower` (power readings integrated: an estimate).

estimated.description: Integrated from power readings rather than measured by a meter.

EnergyHourlyDto.description: The energy one endpoint used in one hour.

passphrase.description:
12–256 characters: the integrations' secrets are included, encrypted with it (AES-256-GCM, key from PBKDF2-SHA256 with
600 000 iterations). Without one the backup has no secrets (integrations need their credentials again after import).
Kept out of URLs on purpose.

ExportBackupRequest.description: Exports the home with its integrations' secrets (`POST /api/backup/export`, Admin).

key.description: camelCase member name of the submitted `config` object.

advanced.description: Rarely changed: shown folded away under "Advanced", after the other fields.

FloorBackgroundDto.description:
The image under a floor plan: its top-left corner sits at (OffsetXCm, OffsetYCm)
and one image pixel measures CmPerPx centimetres.

widthCm.description: Plan width (the SVG viewBox is `0 0 WidthCm HeightCm`).

rowVersion.description: Opaque concurrency token; a change sent with an older one gets 409 `floors.concurrency`.

placements.description: The endpoints and devices on this floor (`PUT /api/placements`; not part of the layout's concurrency token).

FloorDto.description: A floor with its rooms and the devices placed on it. Send RowVersion back with every change to it.

FloorSummaryDto.description: A floor in the floor list.

flowId.description: Send the answer to `POST /api/integrations/flows/{flowId}`; flows expire 15 minutes after their last step.

stepId.description: The connector's id of the step (for its form, progress, choose and external page steps).

FlowStepDto.description:
One step of a setup or reauth flow. Type says which members apply:
            * form:  (render with the schema form),  (initial values,
            never secrets),  (messages by field key after a rejected submission). Send the values.
* externalUrl: open  (https);  is the field to paste the
            result into, if any. Send { "<pasteBack.key>": "…" } or {}.
* progress: waiting for something on the device for at most ; poll with
            {} (about every second) until the step changes.
* choose: pick one of ; send { "choice": "<key>" }.
* done: finished;  is the integration created or updated. The flow is gone.
* abort: the flow cannot continue:  (stable snake_case) and
            . The flow is gone.
            Texts come from the connector in both UI languages.

t.description:
Raw: when the value was observed (the first point may sit at the range's start, carrying the value in effect then).
Statistics: the bucket's start.

v.description:
Raw: the number (booleans as 1/0), or `null` for a string or unknown value. Measurements: the time-weighted mean.
Counters: the increase in the bucket (for energy, Wh used).

min.description: Measurements (5m/1h): the lowest value in the bucket.

max.description: Measurements (5m/1h): the highest value in the bucket.

s.description: Raw: a string value (enum states such as `heat`).

HistoryPointDto.description: One point of a history series.

unit.description: The attribute's canonical unit (`W`, `Wh`, `°C`, `%`, …), if it has one.

HistorySeriesDto.description: An attribute's history over a range, oldest point first (at most 5 000 points: the most recent ones).

pricePerKwh.description: Flat electricity price per kWh (tariff kind `flat`), if known.
Flat electricity price per kWh, if known.

code.description: Stable, dotted error code (e.g. auth.invalid_credentials); the UI translates errors.<code>.

traceId.description: Correlates the response with the server log.

statusMessage.description: A short non-secret explanation of the status, if any.

IntegrationDto.description: An integration in the integrations list.

message.description: A short non-secret explanation, if any.

LocalizedTextDto.description: A text in both UI languages.

rememberMe.description: Keep the session cookie across browser restarts (30-day sliding expiration).

PagedResultOfAuditEntryDto.description: A page of items; pass NextCursor back as `cursor` to get the next page (null = last page).

endpointId.description: Set when an endpoint is placed (then DeviceId is `null`).

deviceId.description: Set when a whole device is placed (then EndpointId is `null`).

roomId.description: The room that contains the point (first in the floor's room order), or `null`.

PlacementDto.description: An endpoint or device on a floor plan.

endpointId.description: The endpoint to place (one control of a multi-channel device, or any single-endpoint device).

deviceId.description: The device to place as a whole.

PlaceRequest.description:
Places an endpoint or a whole device on a floor, or moves it there (`PUT /api/placements`, Admin). Exactly one of
EndpointId and DeviceId. The target's room becomes the room containing the point
(none when it is outside every room).

PointCmDto.description: A point on a floor plan in centimetres (origin: the floor's top-left corner; y grows downwards).

code.description: Stable, dotted error code (e.g. auth.invalid_credentials); the UI translates errors.<code>.

traceId.description: Correlates the response with the server log.

newDeviceId.description: The device taking over (typically the same hardware re-paired, or its successor).

ReplaceDeviceRequest.description:
Replaces a device by another one (`POST /api/devices/{id}/replace`, Admin): the new device takes over the old one's
name, room, icon, endpoint settings, favorites, placements and history; the old device is deleted.

ResetPasswordRequest.description: An Admin sets a new password for another user.

ResetPasswordWithTokenRequest.description: Consumes a one-time reset token printed by the `reset-admin` command.

stateLogDays.description: Raw history (every change), used for ranges up to 6 h.

shortTermStatsDays.description: 5-minute statistics, used for ranges up to 7 days.

RetentionSettingsDto.description: How long history is kept (hourly statistics and hourly energy are kept forever).

polygon.description: The outline (implicitly closed), in the floor's centimetre coordinates.

areaM2.description: Enclosed area in m², rounded to two decimals.

id.description: An existing room of this floor, or `null` for a new room.

polygon.description:
At least 3 points, simple (no self-intersection), inside the floor and enclosing an area; violations are field errors
under `rooms[i].polygon` with codes `geometry.*`.

RoomInput.description: A room in a layout save.

RoomListItemDto.description: A room in the list of all rooms (for pickers).

isSet.description: Whether the user has a PIN (changing it then needs the current one).

lockedForSeconds.description: Seconds left of a lockout after too many wrong PINs, or `null`.

SafetyPinStatusDto.description: The signed-in user's safety PIN state (`GET /api/auth/me/pin`).

SaveFloorLayoutRequest.description:
Replaces the floor's rooms atomically (Admin): listed rooms with an `id` are updated, rooms without one are
created, rooms not listed are deleted; the list order becomes the display order.

ScheduledBackupDto.description: One automatic backup (a zip without credentials): download it with `GET /api/backup/scheduled/{name}`.

enabled.description: Backups are written on a schedule (off: only "back up now" writes one).

intervalHours.description: How often one is written (24: every day).

keep.description: How many are kept; older ones are deleted.

lastFailedAtUtc.description: When the last attempt failed, if it did and none succeeded since (show a warning).

ScheduledBackupsDto.description: The automatic backups (`GET /api/backup/scheduled`, Admin): the schedule, how it went, the files kept.

SetFavoriteRequest.description: Adds an endpoint to (or removes it from) the dashboard's favorites (`PUT /api/endpoints/{id}/favorite`, Member).

currentPin.description: The PIN in use, to change it (wrong ones count towards the safety lockout).

currentPassword.description:
The account password: required to set the first PIN, and to replace a PIN without CurrentPin (a
forgotten one). Checked like a sign-in (wrong ones count towards the account lockout).

SetPinRequest.description: Sets or changes the signed-in user's safety PIN (`PUT /api/auth/me/pin`).

databaseConfigured.description: Whether a database connection is configured (either source).

databaseSource.description:
Where the connection comes from: `environment` (`ConnectionStrings__ControlHome`), `file` (saved by the
setup wizard) or `none` (pre-database setup mode: `POST /api/setup/database`).

databaseError.description: While DatabaseState is `Failed`: the error code, e.g. `db.connection_failed`.

SetupStatusDto.description: First-run state. Answered even while the database is not ready (then SetupCompleted is false).

connectorKey.description: A key from `GET /api/connectors`. Connectors without a flow of their own get a single form with their config fields.

StartFlowRequest.description: Starts a connector's setup flow (`POST /api/integrations/flows`, Admin).

StateDelta.description: A new current value of one attribute (hub `StateChanged`).

b.description: Set when StateValueKind StateValue.Kind is StateValueKind.Bool.

n.description: Set (finite) when StateValueKind StateValue.Kind is StateValueKind.Number.

s.description: Set when StateValueKind StateValue.Kind is StateValueKind.String.

j.description: A JSON object or array, set when StateValueKind StateValue.Kind is StateValueKind.Json.

StateValue.description:
An attribute value as it travels in DTOs and hub messages: `{ kind: 'bool'|'number'|'string'|'json'|'null', b?, n?,
s?, j? }` — exactly the member named by StateValueKind StateValue.Kind is set. Create values with the factories
(StateValue StateValue.Bool(bool value), StateValue StateValue.Number(double value), StateValue StateValue.String(string value), StateValue StateValue.Json(JsonElement value), StateValue StateValue.Null,
StateValue StateValue.FromJson(JsonElement value)); equality compares JSON values structurally.

StateValueKind.description: Which member of a StateValue holds the value (stored as `tinyint`).

StepUpRequest.description: Proves the PIN before a safety-critical command (`POST /api/auth/step-up`).

contentType.description: Always `image/webp` for images (they are re-encoded on upload).

StoredFileDto.description: A stored file. Its bytes are at `GET /api/files/{id}` (immutable: a new upload gets a new id).

runtimeMode.description: `Starting`, `Active` or `Standby` (show a banner when not Active).

historyPaused.description:
The database could not keep up (or is down) and state history was dropped; current state and control keep working.
Cleared once the backlog is written.

icon.description: An icon key (lowercase letters, digits, `-` and `:`), or `null` for the class's default.

UpdateDeviceRequest.description: Renames a device, sets its icon and room (`PUT /api/devices/{id}`, Admin).

name.description: The endpoint's own name, or `null` to show the device's.

roomId.description: The endpoint's own room, or `null` to inherit the device's.

hidden.description: Leave it out of dashboards and pickers.

oneOf.description: The background image, or `null` to remove it.

UpdateFloorRequest.description:
Changes a floor's properties (Admin); rooms are kept. The size cannot shrink below a room (400 with
`errors.widthCm`/`errors.heightCm` = `geometry.out_of_bounds`).

enabled.description: A disabled integration's runtime does not run; its devices stay (availability Unknown).

UpdateIntegrationRequest.description: Renames an integration and enables or disables it (`PUT /api/integrations/{id}`, Admin).

UpdateRetentionSettingsRequest.description: Changes how long history is kept (Admin).

UserDto.description: A household account as seen by an Admin.

ValueSchema.description:
The shape of one value: an attribute's state, a command argument or a connector configuration field. A closed set of
records serialized polymorphically with the discriminator `type` (`bool`, `number`, `enum`,
`string`, `flags`, `json`, `momentary`); the web app renders every schema-driven control from it.

values.description: The allowed values, in display order; never empty.

ValueSchemaEnumSchema.description: One of a fixed list of string values (an endpoint's constraints may allow only a subset).

ValueSchemaFlagsSchema.description: A set of named flags (a bitmap), as a JSON array of distinct flag names.

ValueSchemaJsonValueSchema.description: Any JSON value (read-only data such as a vendor's raw structure).

events.description: The event names this attribute emits (e.g. `single`, `double`, `long`); empty means any.

ValueSchemaMomentarySchema.description:
An event without lasting state (a button press, a doorbell ring). A momentary attribute is updated only through
connector events (`IConnectorContext.ReportEvent`): its value is the last event name and its observed time is when
that event happened.

step.description: Granularity: valid values are `(Min ?? 0) + k × Step`.

maxLength.description: Maximum length in UTF-16 code units, if any.
